description: Maple is an open-source observability platform for traces, logs, metrics, and browser sessions built on OpenTelemetry and ClickHouse. It can run as a hosted service or locally as a single binary with embedded storage and dashboard.
summary: Maple exposes an OTLP-style ingest HTTP API at ingest.maple.dev authenticated by a Bearer project ingest key, a public no-auth local-mode HTTP server on localhost, an MCP server documented on maple.dev with undetermined connect URL/auth details, and a `maple` CLI that supports local mode and hosted-workspace login via `maple login`.

surfaces.name: Maple local query and ingest server
